text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal matches the true procedure (weather 10-day lookup, BBC \"{city} strike\" search, email with the same subject and body) but it has three problems: it ends with \"Send the email\" when the true workflow clicks Discard and never sends, it uses a vague \"recipient\" parameter instead of {traveler}@example.com, and it adds an undefined {name} parameter, so an automation built from it would be ambiguous and could send the email."}

data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (weather 10-day lookup, BBC "{city} strike" search, email with the same subject and body) but it has three problems: it ends with "Send the email" when the true workflow clicks Discard and never sends, it uses a vague "recipient" parameter instead of {traveler}@example.com, and it adds an undefined {name} parameter, so an automation built from it would be ambiguous and could send the email.
